Numerals and features

NIGHT TRAINNIGHT TRAIN

Weight is animated through the variable axis, so the width of each line changes and the lines push against each other.
Signature
Lineup lines arrive once in sequence: each slides 40 px from the left while its weight climbs from hairline 100 to black 900, the line before it settling as the next starts. About 1.4 s in total, then still.
Use when
Festivals, club nights, sport fixtures, launch teasers, social video title cards.
Turns into slop when
When the motion loops or reacts to every scroll tick, when it delays content people need (tickets, dates), or when it is used on a calm product.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
Specimen copy is placeholder text written for this library; it describes no real product or result.
